_comment: Hardware presets for guests that break on modern QEMU defaults. Sourced from the Computernewb QEMU install guides (legacy Windows) and Batocera's own runQemu.sh. Keys: cpu (null = QEMU default, 'host' becomes 'max' under TCG), machine (-M value without accel), vga (QEMU args), vga_modes (alternative vga sets selectable with --gpu-mode), nic (null/'none' = no network), ram_mb (omit = use the run setting, null = do not pass -m), disk (size for a freshly created disk), kvm (true = use KVM when available), boot (cdrom|floppy), rtc, extra (raw args), hostfwd (host->guest TCP forwards, bound to 127.0.0.1), tb_size_mb (cap on the TCG translation cache in MB, used only when running without KVM), vcpus_tcg (vCPU count to use without KVM, where extra vCPUs only add overhead).

winnt4.name: Windows NT 4.0
winnt4.notes: NT4 setup cannot format a partition larger than 4 GB, so the disk is capped there. Newer CPU models trigger a setup BSOD.

winme.name: Windows Me
winme.notes: Me is unstable under KVM (lockups, BSODs), so it always runs under TCG.

winxp.name: Windows XP
winxp.notes: Tuned for phones without KVM (Termux): 512 MB RAM and a 256 MB translation cache keep QEMU from growing until Android kills it. qemu64 boots both 32-bit and x64 XP. The USB tablet keeps the VNC pointer aligned. XP has no built-in driver for --audio hda; try sb16, or ac97 with the Realtek AC97 driver.

win98.name: Windows 98
win98.notes: A VXD/protection BSOD on first boot means the CPU model disagrees with Win98: pass --extra-qemu-args '-cpu core2duo' (Intel host) or '-cpu Opteron_G2' (AMD host). Use --bios-url with the SeaBIOS build that has CONFIG_PNPBIOS disabled if the PnP BIOS is misdetected as a PCI bus.

win95.name: Windows 95
win95.notes: Needs the patcher9x boot floppy (JHRobotics/patcher9x) via --floppy-url. The multi-part install is done by hand over VNC. No -m is passed, so QEMU's own default RAM applies unless you set one in --extra-qemu-args.

win31.name: Windows 3.1
win31.notes: Installs from a DOS boot floppy plus install floppies; provide the DOS floppy via --floppy-url.

win1x.name: Windows 1.x
win1x.notes: DOS-hosted, installs from a single floppy; no network.

batocera.name: Batocera
batocera.notes: Batocera's X server needs a DRM/KMS GPU device. 'virtio' matches the official runQemu.sh; if Xorg reports 'no screens found', try --gpu-mode bochs or std. The official script's USB joystick passthrough is not wired.
